description: Link / URL phishing pre-check before an agent opens, clicks or forwards a link: brand look-alikes (typosquats, homoglyphs, brand in subdomain), punycode and mixed-script hosts, credentials-in-URL tricks, high-abuse TLDs, domain age via RDAP (new domains flagged), DNS resolution and the full redirect chain. Returns a verdict, a 0-100 risk score and the flags. Price: $0.003 USDC on Base per call (x402).
name: web_link_check
